When the Sessions rail already knows the selected thread has a newer running follow-up, the Work pane now merges that selected-thread background task into its visible task list before computing active run cards, queue rows, elapsed counters, and previews.

Pasted screenshots now show as removable thumbnails in the chat bar, travel with new/steer/queued Agent-run payloads as structured attachments, and the provider multimodal helper accepts inline image data URLs as well as local image paths.
- [fix] Reopened source-structure recovery reads after guarded edit failures. When a `file_edit`/`file_write` is rejected by the source-shape guard after the normal final-read budget was already consumed, the tool loop now restores one focused `file_read` from the original allowed tool set, clears the stale consumed flag, and records the recovery-enabled tools before returning to direct-write mode.

Startup restore now tracks a hidden in-flight target while it hydrates historical run records/events, then commits the restored board only after history is ready, so thread/workspace refreshes cannot start repeated `/agent-runs/.../events` bursts or visibly clear/reload the Work panel.
- [fix] Hardened `workspace_check` syntax validation for mixed frontend projects. CSS files now use a lightweight registered source-shape profile, and unsupported `syntax=auto` file types return structured informational results instead of raising run-blocking exceptions.
- [fix] Surfaced shared blocker evidence on blocked Work cards. If a failed task only has generic progress such as "DAN needs attention" but related worker evidence carries a concrete blocker, the Execution and Final response cards now show that blocker instead of saying no error reason was emitted.
- [fix] Made Work Run Steps card visibility consistent. The main card stack now shows only done, active, or blocked steps, while future/planned nodes stay available to the Live Task Graph and preview context instead of appearing during request understanding and disappearing during execution.

## 2026-04-17
- [fix] Made DAN Code benchmark loops harder to exit honestly. Benchmark-mode review normalization no longer converts a `continue` decision into `done` just because a material patch exists, `dan code` now gives SWE-bench runs four supervised passes, marks the result `incomplete` when the reviewer still requests continuation after that budget, and only writes SWE-bench prediction artifacts for the final completed report.
- [fix] Filtered SWE-bench prediction patches so benchmark test files named by the instance metadata (`selected_test_files_to_run`, `FAIL_TO_PASS`, or `PASS_TO_PASS`) are excluded from exported `model_patch`; benchmark prompting now also tells the organism to use tests for validation without adding or editing them in the final prediction patch.
- [test] Added SWE-bench regressions proving repeated benchmark `continue` reviews exhaust without appending `predictions.jsonl`, material benchmark output no longer overrides reviewer `continue`, and metadata-derived test-file diffs are filtered from prediction patches. Validation: `python -m py_compile src/dan/cli/code.py tests/test_cli/test_code.py tests/test_worker/test_coding_conversation.py` and `PYTHONPATH=src:. pytest -q tests/test_cli/test_code.py tests/test_worker/test_coding_conversation.py tests/eval/test_swebench_runner.py` (`65 passed`).
- [fix] Changed DAN Research's default final console renderer from an internal diagnostic envelope into a user-facing research memo. `src/dan/cli/research.py` now suppresses status/run IDs/confidence/log paths/quality-gate tables in normal output while preserving the full structured artifact through `--json` and `--output`; README, architecture, and todo docs now record that split.
- [fix] Aligned the remaining DAN Research review/orchestrator prompt text with the simplified controller logic. `src/dan/worker/organisms/research_conversation.py` no longer tells the review model to continue solely for low confidence, provisional readiness, or imperfect quality-gate metadata, and `src/dan/worker/organisms/project_execution.py` now describes continuation planning as deterministic follow-up narrowing instead of another heavyweight continuation-planner pass.
- [refactor] Trimmed stale post-simplification DAN Research review code in `src/dan/worker/organisms/research_conversation.py` by removing dead continuation-gate helpers, dropping an unused review parameter, and collapsing a redundant fallback branch after the control-shell simplification. No behavior change intended; this was a cleanup pass after the initial simplification landed.
- [refactor] Simplified DAN Research’s control shell so the durable planner now runs only on the initial user ask, while continuation turns narrow deterministically from the latest report and review output instead of paying for another heavyweight continuation-planner LLM call. `src/dan/cli/research.py` now falls back directly to deterministic follow-up planning for continuation turns, which removes the repeated three-minute planner stalls without changing the bounded deep-research organ substrate.
- [fix] Relaxed DAN Research’s stop/continue rules to the minimal honest blockers instead of gate-driven perfectionism. `src/dan/worker/organisms/research_conversation.py` now only forces another pass for missing material output, missing evidence refs, non-completed/error runs, conflicted facts, blocking audit issues, or weakly resolved contradictions; provisional reports can now stop with explicit caveats instead of looping just because confidence/readiness/quality-gate metadata is not perfect.

## 2026-04-01
- [fix] **Full-screen DAN chat history now discovers threads across workflows instead of hiding them behind the current workflow id.** The backend now exposes `GET /api/chats` via `ChatStore.list_all_threads()`, and full-screen `editor/src/components/ChatPanel.tsx` now uses that global thread list/search while keeping the compact sidebar scoped to the active workflow. Cross-workflow thread rows/search results show the owning workflow, and thread actions (`select`, `pin`, `export`, `delete`) now carry explicit `(workflow_id, thread_id)` targeting so histories saved under `_scratch` or older named workflows remain discoverable after workflow switches / Save As. Validation: `pytest -q tests/test_server/test_chat_mode.py tests/test_server/test_chat_integration.py -k 'thread_create_list_get or thread_list_all_workflows or search_finds_messages or search_empty_query_returns_empty or lists_threads_across_workflows'` (`5 passed, 41 deselected`) and `cd editor && npm run build` (passed; existing Node `20.17.0` vs Vite `20.19+` warning only).
- [docs] Reviewed and patched plans 46/47 to match the intended delivery order. `docs/todo.md` now sequences `46-universal-worker-primitive` before `47-agent-output-linter`, the 46-series plans now treat Worker contract metadata as the canonical surface and define an explicit handoff gate for the follow-on worktree, and the 47-series plans now stay architecturally decoupled while being explicitly scheduled after 46 so lint-config autogen targets Worker-first contracts instead of the current heterogeneous node set.
- [docs] **Created plan 47: Agent Output Linter.** Added top-level plan `47-agent-output-linter.md` and five sub-plans (`47-1` through `47-5`) for a fast, inline validation layer at every agent-to-agent handoff. The linter runs three tiers of validation: structural (deterministic, near-zero cost), semantic (lightweight embedding/keyword checks), and intent (focused LLM judgment, only when ambiguous). It lives in a self-contained `src/dan/linter/` module with zero imports from `dan.engine`, `dan.worker`, or `dan.models` — backends (embedder, LLM judge) are injected as callables. Lint config lives per-edge in `DataEdge.metadata["lint"]`, not per-node, so different consumers of the same output can have different validation standards. Auto-fix can repair common issues (fill defaults, clamp ranges, truncate, retry with feedback). Integration point is the scheduler's `port_data.set()` handoff (47-5). The topology compiler will auto-generate lint configs from worker contracts. Plans 46 (Worker) and 47 (Linter) are independent peers — no cross-dependency. Updated `docs/todo.md` to track the full 47-* plan tree at the top of the current backlog.
- [docs] **Reviewed and patched all 46-series plans for clean architecture.** Reframed the universal Worker primitive around three key principles: zero-config defaults ("it just works"), roles as named presets (not types), and a clean self-contained `src/dan/worker/` module structure. Restructured the Worker model to avoid the "grab bag" problem: LLM-specific fields move into an optional `LLMHints` sub-model, control flow fields into `ControlFlowConfig`, and the Worker's top-level fields are organized into three clear groups (Identity, Capability, Composition). Added PASSTHROUGH execution mode for bare Workers. Added auto-detection design to the executor plan. Reframed 46-3 from "type derivation" to "roles, presets & equivalence" with tiered conversion tables. Trimmed premature `squad()/pipeline()/fan_out()` from 46-4 to keep focus on the core `worker()` method. All six plans updated.
- [docs] **Created plan 46: Universal Worker Primitive.** Added top-level plan `46-universal-worker-primitive.md` and five sub-plans (`46-1` through `46-5`) to replace DAN's 21 specialized node types with a single universal `Worker` primitive. The Worker is a minimal contract-based orchestrator that prefers script/code execution over LLM API calls. Approach: strangler fig — add Worker alongside existing types, prove equivalence, then gradually migrate. Sub-plans cover: model/type system (46-1), executor with auto-detected script-first dispatch (46-2), roles/presets and equivalence proof for all 21 existing types (46-3), builder DSL and authoring integration (46-4), and migration/deprecation/compaction (46-5). Updated `docs/todo.md` to track the full 46-* plan tree at the top of the current backlog.

- [fix] **Landed the first canonical-node-taxonomy alignment slice across runtime support, planner honesty, and guardrail tests.** `NodeTypeRegistry` now covers `human`, `agent_team`, and `vote`; validator known/composite sets now include `reflection` / `goal_loop` and validate missing sub-graph refs for `goal_loop`, `parallel_subagents`, `orchestrator`, and `agent_team`; scheduler slot bypass now uses canonical `rag_operator`; planner prompts no longer advertise unsupported `for_each` / wrong `remove_edge` / `tool_name` shapes; `_compile_generate_spec()` now infers real linear source ports and requires explicit gate source ports; and unknown intent-compiler tool stages now fall back to `llm_operator` nodes instead of generating invalid `tool_id="llm_operator"` tool nodes. - [fix] **The chat portal now correctly supports distinct `session_id` and `thread_id` values, and lane-scoped server state follows the narrower session key.** `ChatMessageRequest` no longer rejects callers that intentionally provide different execution-lane and conversation-thread identifiers, non-concierge chat now passes `session_id` through to `ChatManager`, tier executors prefer `msg.session_id` over metadata `thread_id` when constructing `thread_id` for `ChatManager`, and `/cost` now queries telemetry/citation-thread metadata against the session key first. This makes the Telegram fleet lane-concurrency change match the live API contract instead of being blocked or partially collapsed back onto the broad thread key. Also converted the taxonomy backlog note in `docs/todo.md` into the new linked `40-*` planning family so the work now has an executable roadmap.
- [docs] **Reopened `29-5-concierge-parallelism` in place instead of creating a nested follow-up plan.** The plan now captures the remaining concierge efficiency gaps directly under the existing file: coarse dispatcher-side LLM slot accounting, the current serial fallback for `child_execution="mixed"`, and the need for focused throughput regressions. Synced `docs/todo.md` plus the parent Phase 29 plan so the tracking docs no longer disagree about whether this refinement work is still open.
- [fix] **Telegram fleet now keeps ordinary chat continuity by default, but still forks concurrent lanes when another turn is already active.** Non-reply Telegram turns stay on the shared conversation lane unless a same-conversation dispatch is already in flight; only then does fleet fork a narrower per-message `session_id`, while explicit replies still reuse the replied lane. This preserves normal follow-up continuity without giving up concurrent unrelated turns.
- [fix] **Forked Telegram lanes now inherit broad conversation history and feed their replies back into it.** Lane-specific turns seed from the shared conversation log, append their own assistant replies back into that broader history, and keep per-lane outbound progress ownership. This lets two Telegram lanes run concurrently without making later non-reply follow-ups lose recent context. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_adapters/test_telegram.py tests/test_server/test_portal_contract.py -q`.
- [fix] **Messaging now auto-rechecks stale red health once without waiting for a human click.** `useMessagingStore` schedules one silent `refreshStatus()` about 1.5s after the shell Messaging state turns red while another provider is still active, but skips the retry during an in-flight connect/reconnect/disconnect action. This clears transient stale-red cases for remote Telegram use without forcing a disruptive reconnect loop. Validation: `cd editor && npx vitest run src/store/__tests__/useMessagingStore.test.ts`.
- [fix] **Messaging no longer shows a red shell pill just because a healthy adapter still has a stale error string.** `useMessagingStore.buildMessagingSummary()` now keys red/error state off the current provider connection state instead of any leftover `lastError`, and adapter status events now clear cached `last_error` when a provider reports `connected` or `disconnected`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_adapters/test_status_snapshots.py -q` and `cd editor && npx vitest run src/store/__tests__/useMessagingStore.test.ts`.
- [docs] Added backlog items for messaging status-pill correctness, end-to-end messaging/concierge architecture documentation, concurrent messaging-session audit, and canonical node-taxonomy simplification so the current architecture review turns into tracked follow-up work.

## 2026-03-19
- [fix] **Workflow-run follow-ups are no longer conflated with Furnace session control.** Recent workflow-build conversations that later say “run/test/execute it” now get a dedicated `workflow_run` action hint that maps to `start_run`, while explicit Furnace wording still stays on `run_control` and `http_request`. This prevents ordinary workflow execution from being steered into `/api/furnace/*` session endpoints. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow build replies now surface the saved workflow identity more clearly, and run guidance is less ambiguous.** The codegen success path in `ChatManager` now says which current workflow ID the graph was saved to, includes the workflow name when present, and previews the first few node names instead of only reporting node/edge counts. Prompt guidance now also states that ordinary workflow execution should use `start_run` and should not use `http_request` / Furnace endpoints. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow-build turns now self-repair small compilation/validation mistakes internally instead of surfacing them immediately.** The mutation retry loop now uses a dedicated repair prompt with structured context: user request, current workflow summary, the proposed mutation plan, and the exact compilation/validation failures. The model is instructed to preserve the user's requested workflow behavior and only fix mechanical graph-compilation, schema, or validation issues. Both `MutationPlan` validation exceptions and `GraphMutator` dry-run failures are caught and passed through the same bounded repair loop (max 2 attempts by default). The fallback text-streaming path also now catches plan-validation crashes instead of aborting the entire turn. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow chat now covers the basic preview → apply → run loop much more smoothly.** Approval turns like `good please apply` now stay in the workflow-edit lane instead of falling back to Ask/read-only mode, chat gained a first-class `apply_last_mutation` capability for applying the latest proposed workflow preview from the current thread, `ChatManager` now persists the latest proposed mutation preview in thread metadata so later apply turns have a reliable server-side target, and `GraphMutator` now safely handles remove-then-recreate plans for reused node IDs such as `workflow_input` without tripping duplicate-ID dry-run failures. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_graph_mutator.py -q`.
- [perf] **Server startup reduced from ~33s to ~1s by deferring heavy memory kernel imports to background threads.** `ConversationAdapter.import_all` (scans full chat history) and `ProfileAdapter.import_profile` now run in `asyncio.to_thread()` background tasks instead of blocking the lifespan. Self-knowledge RAG indexing, telemetry pruning, and experience imports are also deferred. Added per-phase timing to the lifespan (logged at INFO) to catch future regressions. Also increased `dan-up`'s health timeout from 25s to 60s and stopped killing slow-starting servers on timeout.
- [feat] **Development-mode copy/paste now behaves more like Cursor when pasting code into chat.** `MonacoTabs.tsx` now remembers the active file path plus selected line range on normal editor copy, and `editor/src/lib/clipboardContext.ts` plus the `ChatPanel` / `ModeChatSidebar` paste handlers now reconstruct that metadata into a chat-friendly code context block (`path + line range + fenced code`) when the copied text is pasted back into DAN chat. The clipboard plain-text payload remains raw code so external pastes keep the usual behavior, while same-app chat paste can still recover file+line context through HTML metadata or the in-memory last-copy fallback. Review follow-up also tightened the plain-text fallback matcher to avoid false positives on ordinary comments and added HTML-entity decoding for quoted code. Validation: `cd editor && npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/clipboardContext.test.ts` and `cd editor && npm run build`.
- [fix] **Kimi-backed low-budget report generations no longer burn their output budget on hidden reasoning, and the watchlist equity workflow validates end-to-end again.** `OpenAIProvider` now routes Moonshot's `thinking` control through `extra_body`, auto-disables thinking for low-budget non-tool `kimi-k2.5` calls with the documented non-thinking temperature, and falls back to regular completion text when Kimi streaming yields empty deltas. Also cleaned `_scratch` summary extraction so the aggregate watchlist index renders a readable recommendation line instead of markdown fragments. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_providers/test_model_selector_provider_resolution.py tests/test_providers/test_openai_provider_streaming.py -q` plus live `_scratch` reruns against the watchlist CSV.
- [fix] **Review patch: `/cost` now reads citation-summary metadata from the current request’s chat thread instead of guessing the workflow.** The fast-command path already receives `workflow_id` / `thread_id` in `SurfaceMessage.metadata`, but `/cost` previously preferred an active project's linked workflow or `capability_context.workflow_id`, which could point at the wrong thread and hide/show the wrong citation counts. `runtime.py` now prefers request-scoped metadata first, with a focused regression in `tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_terminal_output.py -q`.
- [fix] **Review patch: citation verification no longer bleeds across different claims that cite the same source index.** `build_citation_records()` now matches verification results by `(citation_index, normalized claim_text)` instead of source index alone, so a verified numeric claim like `24% in 2025 [1]` does not incorrectly mark another claim citing `[1]` as verified. Added a focused regression in `tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py`. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_terminal_output.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.
- [feat] **Closed the remaining Phase 39 citation follow-ups.** Anthropic-native citations are now extracted from raw assistant payloads into structured `CitationRecord` / verification data even when the assistant does not emit `[N]` markers, chat replay has a focused regression proving structured search-result blocks survive the `ChatManager` tool loop, unverified numeric/date claims now surface as separate non-terminal `chat_notice` warnings instead of mutating the assistant answer, and `/cost` now includes the latest citation verification summary from thread metadata. Follow-up hardening added explicit regressions for terminal-output collapsing, editor stream handling of `chat_notice`, and broader chat-router/visibility coverage. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_terminal_output.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_providers/test_anthropic_provider.py tests/test_search_models.py tests/test_concierge/test_chat_router.py tests/test_concierge/test_visibility_feedback.py -q` and `cd editor && npm run test -- --run src/lib/__tests__/editorChat.test.ts`.
- [feat] **Landed the main Phase 39 web-search hardening slice across search, chat, provider replay, and CLI docs.** Added canonical `SearchResultSet` / citation models plus audit persistence, intent-aware auto-grounding with query-relevant fetched excerpts, `/search` and lightweight `@web` triggers, heuristic query decomposition + ranking + canonical-URL dedup, Serper/provider-health/domain/location controls, per-turn web budgets, and post-response citation verification metadata. Anthropic raw replay now preserves structured `search_result` tool blocks, `.env.example` / CLI / README docs now advertise the new search controls, and focused regressions cover live-data grounding, explicit `/search`, shared search models, structured source extraction, and Anthropic structured replay. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_concierge/test_fast_commands.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_providers/test_anthropic_provider.py tests/test_search_models.py -q`.
- [docs] **Reconfirmed that the valuable trust hardening remains in-scope for Phase 28 instead of being deferred away.** After a third review of the `39-*` web-search plans, the phase now explicitly keeps both native-provider citation support (`39-1` task 4) and narrow citation verification (`39-5`) as phase-tail work because this is the dedicated web-search wave and there may not be another clean opportunity later. The rollout is still staged: `39-2` / `39-4` / `39-3` plus the minimal `39-1` contract slice land first, then the phase closes with the bounded hardening that still provides clear trust value.
- [docs] **Re-scoped Phase 28 web-search plans around fast quality wins versus optional later trust hardening.** The second review concluded that full native citation plumbing (`39-1` task 4) and post-response citation verification (`39-5`) are not required for the first substantial improvement in search quality. Updated the umbrella plan and `docs/todo.md` to make the rollout order explicit: initial focus is `39-2`/`39-4`/`39-3` plus only the minimal `39-1` contract slice. Also added three concrete medium-effort wins directly into the active plans: adaptive fetch fallback in `39-2`, canonical-URL dedup/source tracking in `39-3`, and explicit per-turn web budgets in `39-4`.
- [docs] **Reviewed and hardened the new Phase 28 web-search plans before implementation.** Patched the `39-*` plan set to align with the real architecture: (1) `39-1` now treats native Anthropic citations as a provider/chat-manager replay-path change rather than a simple handler tweak, preserves fetched excerpts for generic tool loops, uses a canonical `search_result_set` payload, and targets a real shared module path (`src/dan/server/search_models.py`) instead of a non-existent `server/models/` package; (2) `39-2` now routes `/search` through the canonical command registry and uses token-safe `@web` detection / future structured-mention integration; (3) `39-3` keeps URL dedup state local to a tool loop instead of a shared `ChatManager` attribute and avoids over-filtering repeated searches down to zero evidence; (4) `39-4` adds cache-key evolution, preserves explicit provider-order semantics unless a provider is in temporary cooldown, validates mutually exclusive domain filters, and bounds provider fan-out when combined with multi-query search; (5) `39-5` now uses post-response warning events / audit metadata instead of trying to mutate already-streamed assistant text with a late disclaimer.
- [docs] **Created Phase 28 — Web Search Hardening plans (39-1 through 39-5).** Umbrella plan `39-web-search-hardening.md` plus five sub-plans covering: (A) structured `SearchResult`/`CitationRecord` models with Anthropic native citation adapter, (B) intent-aware auto-grounding, query-relevant excerpt extraction, `/search` command, and `@web` mention, (C) multi-query decomposition, TF re-ranking, credibility tiers, cross-turn URL dedup, and thin-result reformulation, (D) Serper (Google) provider, configurable cascade, health tracking, domain/location controls, and multi-provider mode, (E) post-response citation verification and ungrounded-claim detection. Design informed by Claude API's `search_result` blocks and Cursor's `@Web` force-search UX.
- [feat] **Workflow chat now supports end-to-end build-and-run in a single conversational turn.** `plan_graph_mutations` gains an `auto_apply` parameter: when `true` and the dry-run passes, the server applies the mutation and saves the graph immediately, then continues the tool loop so the model can call `start_run` in the same turn. `ChatMutationEvent` now carries an `applied` flag and `_format_mutation_preview_content` surfaces "Built and applied — ready to run" instead of "proposed, not applied yet". Prompt guidance teaches the model to set `auto_apply: true` when the user asks to build AND run/test, and to leave it `false` for preview-only requests. Review hardening: (1) the auto-apply path now marks `plan_graph_mutations` as satisfied so the follow-up tool choice is `auto` instead of being forced back to `plan_graph_mutations`, and (2) text-based mutations with `auto_apply` use a `user` message continuation instead of a `tool` result message, avoiding the API contract violation of orphaned tool result messages. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **`dan-up` no longer kills a slow-starting server prematurely.** Increased `wait_for_health` timeout from 25s to 60s (server startup now takes ~35s with all subsystems). When the timeout does fire, `dan-up` now distinguishes a still-alive server (leaves it running, suggests retrying) from a dead process (cleans up PID file). Previously, any startup exceeding 25s caused `dan-up` to SIGTERM/SIGKILL the server and report failure. Removed unused `signal` import.
- [fix] **Workflow-action follow-ups no longer get stranded in Ask mode with read-only workflow tools.** Audit-log turns like “Sounds good, can you run this workflow to test?” were still reaching `ChatManager` as `mode=ask`, which restricted the prompt to `**Workflow:** list_graphs` plus read-only run/file tools and let the model say it could not build/delete workflows. `src/dan/server/concierge/tier_executors.py` now promotes Ask-mode follow-ups back to `agent` when recent history clearly shows active workflow work and the new turn is operational (`run`, `test`, `build`, `delete`, etc.). Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow inventory + delete chat turns no longer execute speculative stale deletes in the same tool batch.** `src/dan/server/chat_manager.py` now defers `delete_graph` when the same provider response also asked for workflow inventory (`list_graphs`, `list_my_workflows`, `search_workflows`), then injects a follow-up instruction telling the model to delete only exact `graph_id` values from the fresh inventory result. `src/dan/server/capability_handlers.py` also resolves exact workflow-name matches back to `graph_id` and treats already-absent workflows as a safe no-op, which removes the confusing red “not found” tool failures when a workflow is already gone. `src/dan/server/chat/prompts.py` now teaches this delete sequencing explicitly. Validation: `python -m pytest tests/test_concierge/test_live_data.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py -q`.
- [fix] **Workflow chat now keeps the right workflow tools visible on follow-up turns and can delete named workflows directly.** `src/dan/server/concierge/tier_executors.py` now preserves `plan_graph_mutations` for workflow-oriented follow-ups when recent history already shows workflow build activity, which fixes audit-log cases where turns like "so is it gonna work?" were prompted with `**Workflow:** list_graphs` only and then claimed they could not build. `src/dan/server/capability_handlers.py` now exposes write-mode `delete_graph` with `_scratch`/invalid-id guards, and the obsolete equity workflow JSONs were removed from `graphs/` so the local catalog no longer advertises stale research flows. On the editor side, `ChatPanel.tsx`, `ModeChatSidebar.tsx`, `editorChat.ts`, `backgroundStreamRegistry.ts`, `toolCallPresentation.ts`, and the new `chatProgress.ts` helper now prefer `phase_label` text for progress displays, give `plan_graph_mutations` workflow-specific progress copy, and replace stale preview wording with an applied summary after mutation apply. ## 2026-03-18
- [fix] **Workflow-build chat turns can now generate valid `for_each` bodies instead of getting trapped on missing `body_graph` validation errors.** `GraphMutator` now auto-scaffolds empty body sub-graphs when control-flow nodes such as `for_each` / `composite` are added, exposes a new `replace_body_graph` mutation op for populating those nested bodies, and updates the built-in `fan_out` pattern to emit a real body sub-graph instead of an impossible top-level shape. Prompt/schema guidance in `chat/prompts.py` plus the runtime workflow-tool hint in `chat_manager.py` now explicitly teach the model to add the control-flow node first and then define its body with `replace_body_graph`, including the important distinction that top-level `for_each` ports are `items` / `results` while `item` belongs inside the body sub-graph entry node. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_graph_mutator.py`, `tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py`, and revalidated adjacent chat follow-up coverage with `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_graph_mutator.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`.

## 2026-03-18
- [fix] **Workflow-build chat turns now spend less time stalled between discovery and mutation, and harmless mutation drifts no longer blow up dry-run retries.** `ChatManager.send_message_with_tools()` now injects the existing required-action retry prompt into post-tool follow-up turns when the provider cannot be forced onto a specific tool and `workflow_edit` is still missing, so Kimi/auto-compatible turns get an explicit “call `plan_graph_mutations` now” nudge instead of another vague continuation pass. `GraphMutator` now treats `remove_node` on already-missing nodes as an idempotent no-op and normalizes guessed source ports onto the declared port for single-output nodes (including the recurring `for_each.item -> results` and `code_operator.output -> result` drifts), which prevents unnecessary mutation auto-retry loops on workflow-build plans. Added regressions in `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py` and new `tests/test_graph_mutator.py`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_graph_mutator.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py -q`, plus live browser replay after restart that reached `plan_graph_mutations` after a short 2-tool discovery pass instead of getting stuck in the earlier 4-tool discovery-only stall.

## 2026-03-18
- [fix] **Canonical chat-mode aliases now resolve to the correct capability-tool bucket at execution time.** `ChatManager` now normalizes capability-registry lookups/execution through the canonical Agent bucket before advertising tools, extracting tool calls, or dispatching capability handlers, so explicit `build` / `mutate` turns (and any fallback Agent-equivalent path) no longer prompt for tools that the executor silently treats as unavailable. Added a regression in `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py` that proves an Agent-registered capability tool still works when the request mode is `build`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_openai_provider.py`.
- [fix] **Chat-mode workflow builds now see the real request-time tool catalog and avoid Kimi's explicit-tool-choice trap.** `generate_capability_reference()` now summarizes the live capability registry for the current request instead of the static built-in tool library, so chat-mode prompts finally advertise workflow/run/history tools and `plan_graph_mutations` when mutation is allowed. The unified prompt also now states that `plan_graph_mutations` is DAN's workflow-building/editing interface, `OpenAIProvider.get_model_behavior()` disables exact/required `tool_choice` forcing for `kimi-*`, and `ChatManager` retries once with `tool_choice="auto"` if a provider still rejects explicit tool-choice settings under thinking mode. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py`, `tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py`, and `tests/test_openai_provider.py`. Validation: `pytest tests/test_chat_prompt_modules.py tests/test_post_tool_followup_recovery.py tests/test_openai_provider.py tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py tests/test_concierge/test_chat_router.py -q`, plus a live `/api/chat/message` smoke after restarting DAN where `mode=auto` immediately emitted `chat_tool_call_start(tool_name=\"plan_graph_mutations\")` for a simple workflow-build prompt.

- [docs] **Plan 31-33 clarified child-session subagent model and parent-side synthesis review.** Applied two design decisions: (1) child sessions are subagents that inherit context, autonomy, and a synthetic triage from the parent — they do not re-triage or re-run context gathering, so context-gathering changes only affect the root dispatch path; (2) review/remediation is parent-side — after children complete, `_synthesize()` checks results against the original goal and can spawn at most one remediation child (for `aggressive`), replacing the previous plan's auto-injected review children and follow-up children that risked runaway self-review loops. Also clarified the `_build_prompt()` vs `interaction_policy` boundary: `_build_prompt()` carries factual metadata only, behavioral instructions live exclusively in the `interaction_policy` prompt module. - [fix] **Engine runtime parallelism now uses split CPU/LLM throttles without scheduler-level whole-node wrapping.** `executor.py` adds a re-entrant `node_slot()` with timeout-backed acquisition plus `max_subgraph_depth`, `scheduler.py` removes dispatch-time semaphore wrapping from `_guarded_execute_node()`, applies the shared node slot only around CPU-bound node execution, keeps eager-mode `max_concurrency` available for tool-heavy graphs, and fails fast on excessive nested subgraph depth instead of hanging. `control_flow.py` now composes `VoteExecutor`'s local parallelism with the shared node slot, `tests/test_engine/test_scheduler_parallelism.py` grew to 32 engine regressions (including eager node-cap enforcement, deterministic ready-queue tie-breaking, context-edge overlap, repeated-resume memory idempotence, vote composition, and depth-guard coverage), and `tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py` adds a direct proof that `_run_children_parallel()` no longer calls the old `asyncio.sleep(0.01)` busy-poll path. - [fix] **Engine loop resume now re-enters checkpointed cycle work instead of stalling at restored gates.** `scheduler.py` now seeds eager cycle tasks from checkpointed `continue` / `loop` gate outputs, ignores cycle-internal gate-input edges when rebuilding outer ready-state, and normalizes restored `RUNNING` nodes before dispatch so boundary and mid-iteration loop checkpoints resume correctly. `tests/test_engine/test_scheduler_parallelism.py` grew to 25 scheduler regressions covering linear/diamond/wide dispatch invariants, nested `ParallelSubagents` -> `ForEach` semaphore sharing, nested LLM deadlock avoidance, crash/resume equivalence, resumed memory availability, and loop checkpoint resume. - [fix] **Native Cmd+C/Cmd+V now works in chat text/code blocks.** The global graph shortcut hook no longer steals clipboard shortcuts when focus/selection is inside chat-rendered message content, so users can copy selected snippets directly from assistant text/code blocks and paste normally. Added explicit chat clipboard-zone markers in both full Chat (`ChatMessage.tsx`) and per-mode sidebar chat (`ModeChatSidebar.tsx`) to keep native clipboard behavior authoritative in those regions. Validation: `editor npm run build` passes and lints on edited files are clean.
- [fix] **Swift furnace routing across folder/file/topic inputs.** Extended concierge furnace-intent guardrails so users can naturally provide a folder path, file path, or topic-only online learning request and still be routed to `agent` + `target=run` with actionable hints. Furnace turns now preserve `run_control`, add `read_file` for path-based ingestion, add `search_web` for topic-only/online requests, and keep stripping accidental `write_file`/`workflow_edit` drift. Added regressions in `tests/test_concierge/test_triage.py` for folder-path and topic-only prompts.
- [fix] **Chat mode chrome simplification + title hardening.** Reduced stacked bars in full-screen Chat by removing the separate `ThreadTabs` row and keeping a single in-panel header with one `History` toggle (no duplicate history controls). `RecentCommandsBar` is now contextual and only appears when the composer is focused, reclaiming vertical space during normal reading. Title robustness remains hardened: thread titles normalize literal `"undefined"`/`"null"` to empty and fallback labels, preventing broken-looking titles after restore. Validation: `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/chatThreadTitle.test.ts` and `editor npm run build` both pass.
- [fix] **Concierge furnace-intent guardrails to prevent report-writing drift.** Triage now detects furnace/distillation requests (`furnace`, `distillation`, `recipe session`, `pill-*`, `start furnace/session`) and force-routes them to `agent` + `target=run` with `run_control` hints, while stripping accidental `write_file` / `workflow_edit` hints that previously caused responses like “wrote report-2026.tex” instead of API/session control. Path-bearing furnace prompts also retain `read_file` hints for source ingestion context. Added regressions in `tests/test_concierge/test_triage.py` for both LLM-misroute and fallback-unparseable paths.
- [fix] **Furnace start semantics + phase timeout hardening.** New furnace sessions now persist with `status="paused"` so `POST /api/furnace/sessions/{id}/start` actually transitions them into running instead of returning a misleading `409 already active`. The start endpoint is now idempotent (`already_running` no-op) when a run is already in flight, and each furnace phase now has a bounded timeout (`DAN_FURNACE_PHASE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, default 120s) so normalize/extract/aggregate/infer/project can fail fast with explicit `phase_failed` + `session_failed` diagnostics instead of hanging indefinitely at `normalize`.
- [fix] **Clipboard screenshots now work like real attached images in the desktop chat UI.** Pathless pasted screenshots and other data-URL/file attachments are now persisted through a new Electron temp-attachment bridge into `app.getPath("userData")/chat-attachments` before chat requests are sent, so the backend receives a real local path and can inspect them with the normal attachment tools instead of falling back to metadata-only handling. Full Chat also now auto-attaches pasted images immediately instead of requiring a second confirmation click, queued follow-up messages retain their attachments instead of silently dropping them, and unnamed clipboard images now get stable labels like `Pasted Image.png` so attachment chips/cards are never blank. Validation: `editor npm run build`, `editor npm run electron:compile`, `npx vitest run src/lib/__tests__/editorChat.test.ts`, and IDE lints on the edited Electron/chat files pass.
- [fix] **Appended filenames stay visible in Chat and per-mode sidebars.** The chat composer chips now preserve full-name hover titles, and sent message bubbles render clearer attachment cards with filename-first emphasis plus optional path text, so prompts like "summarize this paper" still visibly show which file was appended. Validation: `editor npx tsc --noEmit` passes and IDE lints on the edited UI files are clean.
- [fix] **Editor AI surfaces now use the live chat stack, and per-mode chat can append files/figures.** The shared `editorChat.ts` helper now routes former `/api/chat/editor/message` callers through `/api/chat/message`, so `ModeChatSidebar`, `InlineEdit`, `aiCodeActions`, `WritingPane`, `CodeCells`, and `PageSummary` no longer point at a dead legacy endpoint. `ModeChatSidebar` also gained queued `persistent-chat:send` replay, appended file chips, drag/drop/paste file capture, assistant file/tool-call rendering, and Research mode figure append via a new `Ask AI` action in `FigureGallery`. Full `ChatPanel` now turns appended file chips into explicit prompt context instead of silently dropping them, passes attachment paths through the request body, and the backend now injects those attachment facts as explicit system instructions with tool hints (`pdf_read`, `image_describe`, `csv_read`, `file_read`) so the assistant stops denying visible attachments and can inspect attached image paths when asked. Uploaded research figures now retain their original file path when available, so figure-to-chat handoff can use the vision tool path instead of metadata alone. To keep Cursor-style inline completion working, the backend now exposes `/api/chat/editor/complete` as a compatibility route that forwards completion prompts through the live chat model. Validation: `editor npx tsc --noEmit`, `editor npm run build`, `python -m py_compile src/dan/server/routers/chat.py src/dan/server/concierge/tier_executors.py` pass; live smoke tests confirmed `/api/chat/editor/complete` returns a completion, plain chat acknowledges attached file/image paths, and agent mode can describe an attached image from its path.

Added `name`, `topic`, `description`, `variant_label`, `budget_limit_usd` to `FurnaceSession` model; `SourceStatus` backward-compat alias for `PaperStatus`; `source_queue` property alias. `FurnaceSessionStore` updated with `find_by_name()`, `create_session()` with name/topic/description params, status filter in `list_sessions()`. All patched.
- [fix] **Packaged app chat history now survives restart.** Fixed two release-only persistence bugs in `editor/electron/main.ts`: (1) the production UI server previously used `listen(0)`, so each launch got a different `http://127.0.0.1:<random-port>` origin and all frontend `localStorage` state (workspace store, per-mode sidebar chats, session restore, layout prefs, etc.) appeared to reset on every restart; it now binds to a fixed loopback port `45173`. (2) the packaged backend inherited the default relative `DAN_GRAPHS_DIR=./graphs`, so server-side chat threads/graphs/test cases depended on an arbitrary current working directory; it now forces `DAN_GRAPHS_DIR` to `app.getPath("userData")/graphs` for a stable per-user storage location. Follow-up hardening: added an Electron single-instance lock so relaunching the packaged app focuses the existing window instead of racing the fixed backend/UI ports. Validation: `npm run electron:compile` passes; the broader `editor npm run build` is currently blocked by an unrelated pre-existing TypeScript error in `src/components/code/MergeEditor.tsx` (`theme` is undefined).
- [fix] **Visible chat entry follow-up for Research + Development.** The prior per-mode chat work left the entry point technically present but still too easy to miss. Development mode now has a clearly labeled `AI Chat` button in the top editor toolbar in addition to the activity-bar icon, and Research mode now has both a stronger pill-styled `Chat` toggle in the left rail and a matching labeled `AI Chat` button in the top desk toolbar. This makes the chat entry visibly discoverable even before users know `⌘J`.
- [fix] **Chat layout follow-up: 6 cleanups from review pass.** (1) Removed dead `messagesEndRef` (ref declaration + `<div ref={messagesEndRef} />` marker) — orphaned after replacing `scrollIntoView` with direct `scrollTop`. (2) Fixed EmptyState vertical centering in fullScreen — the `max-w-3xl mx-auto` inner wrapper lacked height so EmptyState's `h-full` + `justify-center` couldn't center; now conditionally adds `h-full` to the wrapper when messages are empty. (3) Fixed EmptyState dark-mode colors — heading was `text-gray-800` (invisible on `#1e1e1e`), prompt cards used `bg-gray-50`/`border-gray-100`; changed to `text-gray-200`, `bg-white/5`, `border-gray-700` with `hover:bg-indigo-500/10`. (4) Fixed `queueStrip` dark-mode colors — `border-gray-100 bg-gray-50/50` and white queue items were jarring in fullScreen; now uses `border-[#3c3c3c] bg-[#252526]` with `bg-white/5 border-gray-700` items. (5) Changed main content column from `overflow-hidden` to `overflow-clip` — `overflow-hidden` creates a scroll container per CSS spec (root cause of the original `scrollIntoView` bug); `overflow-clip` prevents overflow without creating a scroll target. (6) Improved streaming scroll — replaced `smooth` scroll during content updates with instant scroll only when user is already near bottom (within 120px), preventing animation lag during rapid streaming and respecting manual scroll-back.
- [fix] **Chat layout: input no longer blocks entire page.** Two issues fixed: (1) `scrollIntoView()` on the messages-end marker was scrolling ALL scrollable ancestors, including the parent `overflow-hidden` flex-col container (which CSS spec treats as a scroll container). This pushed the conversation header, mode selector, and input area off their correct positions. Replaced all three `scrollIntoView` calls with direct `scrollTop`/`scrollTo` on a new `messagesContainerRef` targeting only the `overflow-y-auto` messages div. (2) Simplified the fragile 3-layer absolute positioning chain (ModePanel → ChatMode → ChatPanel all used `absolute inset-0`) to a single absolute layer (ModePanel) with pure flex layout below: ChatMode root changed from `absolute inset-0 h-full min-h-0` to `h-full flex flex-col`; ChatMode wrapper from `flex-1 min-h-0 h-full relative` to `flex-1 min-h-0`; ChatPanel outer from `absolute inset-0 h-full` to `relative h-full`; ChatPanel main column removed conflicting `h-full` (redundant with `flex-1`); bottomDock removed redundant `mt-auto` (flex-1 on messagesArea already handles it).

Plan covers: (A) delete all three shell components, (B) extract a shared `ModeChatSidebar` with persistent per-workspace history for every non-Chat mode, (C) add Workflow + Furnace activity bar items to Development mode, (D) improve Research right-drawer discoverability.
- [fix] **Progress events no longer terminate client stream.** Changed `_emit_progress()` `detected_mode` from `"progress_generation"` to `"progress_ack"` so eval harness and editor frontend treat keepalive progress events correctly instead of interpreting them as terminal `chat_complete` events.
- [fix] **Quality gate now respects threshold=0 (accept all).** `DAN_GRAPH_QUALITY_THRESHOLD` used `> 0` check, so the default value "0" fell through to tier-adaptive thresholds that reject graphs. Changed sentinel from 0 to -1 for "not set", and condition from `> 0` to `>= 0`. Now: env var unset → tier-adaptive; env var = "0" → no rejection; env var = N → reject below N.
- [fix] **Tool catalog now included in live intent extraction.** The chat_manager intent extraction path built messages without the available tool_id list, so the LLM could invent non-existent tool IDs. Now imports `render_tool_id_list` and appends the catalog to the system prompt, matching the behavior in `extract_workflow_intent()`.
- [feat] **Added `pre_generation_ms` to `ChatGenerationSummaryEvent`.** New optional field tracks pre-generation latency in the summary event. Wired into `_build_summary_event()` (currently `None`; TODO: populate from intent extraction timing).
- [fix] **Structural mutation macros now handle flat edge lists.** `structural_mutations.py` assumed edges were `{"data": [...], "control": [...]}` but the canonical `Graph` model uses a flat `edges: list[Edge]` with `edge_type` discriminator. Added `_get_edges_by_type()` and `_remove_data_edge()` helpers; updated all 5 edge functions and 12 call sites across `wrap_in_review_loop`, `fan_out_node`, `insert_validator`, `insert_tool`, `parallelize`, and `summarize_graph`. Both formats now supported.
- [fix] **Eval harness correctness fixes (10 items).** (1) `.gitignore` re-includes `tests/eval/` and `tests/test_eval_runner.py` so the harness is version-controlled. (2) `run_multi_turn()` now updates `graph_revision` from graph metadata and only checks fixture expectations on the final turn. (3) Durability D2/D4 use `len(errors) == 0` instead of the non-existent `validation["valid"]` field; D4 adds a 3s delay after `send_message` before re-reading. (4) `run_single()` now also calls `_any_event_needs_clarification(events)`, not just `_needs_clarification_reply(response_text)`. (5) `guard_events` field on `EvalRecord` is now populated from stream events. (6) `_run_durability()` requires `validation.passed` when selecting a graph for durability checks. (7) `_validate()` now extracts `message` from dict errors and uses `len(errors) == 0` (same fix as durability). (8) `_try_execute()` now populates `nodes_completed` via `get_run_telemetry()`. (9) `run_tokens` field wired via new `_query_run_tokens()` that queries `workflow_run` telemetry events. (10) `multi_turn_history` now populated in `run_multi_turn()` with the accumulated conversation history.

- [fix] **Chat input floated to the top after sending a message — Electron flex height chain broken.** Neither `h-full` chains nor `flex-1` chains reliably propagated height from `ModePanel (absolute inset-0)` → `ChatMode` → `ChatPanel` in Electron's Chromium. Browser worked fine; Electron did not — the conversation column got `height: auto` and `flex-1` on `messagesArea` had no space to grow. Fix: added a `position: relative` wrapper in `ChatMode` around `ChatPanel`, and changed `ChatPanel`'s fullscreen root to `position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex`. This bypasses all flex/percentage height propagation — dimensions come directly from absolute positioning against the wrapper. Also locked viewport with `html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden }`.
- [fix] **Refresh loaded the wrong chat — `ChatPanel` ignored workspace store.** `ChatPanel` read the saved thread from its own `localStorage` key (`dan_active_thread_${graphId}`), but the workspace store (zustand `persist` with key `dan-workspaces`) already tracks `activeThreadId` per workspace and rehydrates on refresh. On mount, the `useEffect` read from `localStorage` but the workspace store's value was the correct source of truth. Fix: initial thread loading now checks `useWorkspaceStore.getState().getActiveWorkspace()?.activeThreadId` first, falling back to `localStorage` and then `sorted[0]`.
- [fix] **Refresh loaded the first chat instead of the current one — race condition in localStorage persistence.** The `useEffect` that synced `activeThreadId` to `localStorage` fired on mount with `null`, clearing the saved value before the thread-loading effect could read it. Changed the effect to only write when `activeThreadId` is non-null; stale IDs in storage are safely ignored because the loader validates against the live thread list before using them.
- [feat] **Context-aware compaction ratio and pressure hint for long conversations.** The `_compact_context` compaction ratio was a fixed 55% of context window — too conservative for large windows (wasted ~20% of a 200K window). Now scales by window size: 80% for 1M+, 70% for 200K+, 65% for 128K+, 55% for smaller. Configurable via `DAN_COMPACT_CONTEXT_RATIO` env var. Added `context_pressure_hint()` in `chat/tokens.py` — when context usage exceeds 60% of the window (configurable via `DAN_CONTEXT_PRESSURE_THRESHOLD`), a system message is injected: "Save intermediate results to a file with file_write before making more tool calls. Keep your response concise." This gives the LLM a behavioral nudge without raw token counts, following the pattern used by Cursor/Claude Code (system-level management, not model-level arithmetic).
- [fix] **Stopped raw web search/fetch content from leaking into chat responses.** Replaced `combined_text_parts.append(cap_result.message)` in `chat_manager.py` with `_summarize_tool_result()` — a new helper in `chat/helpers.py` that produces one-line summaries like `Searched web for "X" (5 results)` or `Fetched https://... (4,200 chars)` instead of dumping raw content. This fixes 7 fallback paths (cancellation, continuation failure, empty LLM response, timeout, synthesis failure) that previously dumped raw web/file content to the user. Added explicit "never paste raw search results" instruction to the research prompt. Reinforces existing NON-NEGOTIABLE rules 7 and 8.
- [fix] **Initial LLM call timeout now falls back to text-only stream instead of hard-stopping.** Previously, `asyncio.TimeoutError` on the initial `provider.complete()` returned a generic "took too long" message and abandoned the request. Now timeouts are treated like other transient errors — retried once, then fall back to `_stream_with_json_fallback()` (text-only, no tools) before giving up. This gives the user a response instead of a dead end.
- [fix] **Mid-loop timeout now attempts synthesis recovery before dumping.** When the LLM times out during the multi-turn tool loop, the system now tries a no-tools synthesis call asking the model to answer from the tool results already in context. If synthesis succeeds, the user gets a proper response. If it also fails, the error message now includes a bullet-point summary of completed tool steps (from the new `_summarize_tool_result` output) so "continue" has context about what was already done.

## 2026-03-13
- [fix] **Migrated `ChatMessage.tsx` custom markdown renderer to marked v17 token-based API.** The `marked` library was upgraded to v17 which changed the Renderer contract: methods now receive raw token objects instead of pre-rendered HTML strings. The custom renderer was still using the old API, causing tables to render as `[object Object]`, lists as `undefined`, and inline formatting (bold, italic, links) to show raw markdown. Updated all 13 renderer methods (`heading`, `paragraph`, `blockquote`, `table`, `tablecell`, `list`, `listitem`, `strong`, `em`, `del`, `link`, plus kept `code`/`codespan`/`hr` unchanged) to use `this.parser.parseInline(tokens)` for inline content and `this.parser.parse(tokens)` for block content. Switched from arrow functions to regular `function` expressions where `this.parser` access is needed. Zero TypeScript errors, zero linter warnings.
- [feat] **Inject message into active session ("Push" button).** The first queued message now has a "Push" button that injects the message into the active streaming session via `POST /api/chat/{channel}/inject`. The backend `ChatManager` maintains per-stream injection queues; between tool rounds in the multi-turn tool loop, injected messages are drained and appended to the LLM context as user messages. A `ChatInjectedMessageEvent` is emitted on the WebSocket so the frontend inserts the injected message into the conversation above the assistant's ongoing response. This lets users provide additional context or redirect the assistant mid-turn without waiting for the current response to finish.
- [feat] **Message queue: type and queue follow-up messages while DAN is still processing.** When streaming is active, the composer stays enabled with a "Type to queue next message…" placeholder. Enter enqueues the message instead of silently dropping it. Queued messages appear in a strip below the composer with edit (pop back to input), reorder (move up), and delete actions. When the active stream completes, the next queued message auto-sends after a 100ms delay. Queue is cleared on thread switch or new chat. `beforeunload` handler and component unmount both call `shutdownAllBackgroundStreams()` to close all detached WebSockets and flush pending saves when the app closes.
- [feat] **Background streaming: chat sessions keep running when switching threads.** Replaced the bouncing-dots loading placeholder with the progress status text at the top of the assistant bubble. Added clickable "open" link next to file paths in progress text. New `backgroundStreamRegistry.ts` module detaches the active WebSocket into a background registry when switching threads — the stream continues saving to the server and the thread list shows a pulsing indigo dot for threads working in the background. When the background stream completes, the active thread auto-reloads the latest state.
- [refactor] **Replaced hand-rolled markdown renderer with `marked` for proper CommonMark parsing.** `ChatMessage.tsx` now uses the `marked` library with custom renderers for DAN-styled headings, tables, code blocks (hljs), blockquotes, and links. Tables that follow text without a blank line now render correctly instead of showing raw pipe syntax. Math (KaTeX) and @mention extraction still use the placeholder system before `marked` processes the rest. All 66 editor tests pass.
- [fix] **Tiered executor `ChatManager` bridge now preserves request safety metadata.** The initial concierge rewrite fix restored the correct `send_message_with_tools(workflow_id, message, history, ...)` call shape, but the bridge was still dropping `client_graph_revision`, `debug_context`, `mentions`, and triage-derived `required_action_hints`, and it defaulted mutation access too broadly. `tier_executors.py` now forwards the full request envelope that `ChatManager` expects, derives `allow_mutation_tool` conservatively from the `workflow_edit` action hint when no explicit override is present, and falls back to `session_id` for thread continuity. Added focused regressions in `tests/test_concierge/test_tiered_dispatch.py` to lock the metadata bridge and workflow-edit mutation gating in place.
